message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming image data or file paths; the code simply passes data through transforms and DataLoader without any validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: All data is loaded from local filesystem paths (./data/...) with no remote fetching, so there is no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity check for any remote source.

No detected label flipping detection: The code uses ImageFolder and DataLoader without any validation of label distributions, comparison against an expected label set, or use of label-noise detection tools like Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preprocessing pipeline applies only standard transforms (resize, flip, normalize) with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The code constructs the Vgg model from scratch with randomly initialized weights and does not load any pretrained weights or serialized model files, so no integrity verification is needed or performed.

No detected label distribution validation: The code only retrieves class names and count via `loaddata.classes` and `len(classes_)` but performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomaly detection on training samples.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense anywhere in the training pipeline.

No detected differential privacy: The optimizer is a standard `optim.Adam` with no DP-SGD wrapping, and neither Opacus nor TensorFlow Privacy nor any other differential privacy library is imported or used.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics; validation data uses shuffle=True and shares the same preprocessing pipeline without isolation guarantees.

No detected input sanitization: The preprocessing pipeline applies only standard image transforms (resize, flip, normalize) with no shape/range validation, schema checks, or rejection of malformed inputs before passing data to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model outputs for NaN values, probability sanity bounds, or calibrated thresholds anywhere in the visible inference/evaluation code path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a CNN-based image classification model (VGG), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
